name: returning-matches-nothing-counts-zero
derived_from: spec 043 FR-010 and review of D-007: an UPDATE ... RETURNING that matches no row is a write that changed nothing; dbrun.py reports rowcount 0 and a plan expecting 0 commits, so the port reports 0 too (a SELECT stays -1)

sqlite: CREATE TABLE t (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, n INTEGER NOT NULL)

statements: UPDATE t SET n = 5 WHERE id = 99 RETURNING id
